differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the grid, framing the Recurly and Juspay cards more prominently.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further back, resulting in a wider field of view with smaller cards.
differences.fix: Adjust camera distance and focal length to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: Soft contact shadows are visible under the cards and within the grid seams.
differences.b_observable: The contact shadows are extremely faint or missing, making the elements appear to float.
differences.fix: Increase ambient occlusion intensity and shadow map resolution.

differences.a_observable: The overall scene has a warm, cream-colored cast on the white surfaces.
differences.b_observable: The scene has a neutral to cool white cast with higher brightness.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance of the light sources to introduce warmer tones.

differences.a_observable: The background elements show a subtle depth-of-field blur.
differences.b_observable: The entire frame is in sharp focus from foreground to background.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field and set the focus distance to the main cards.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position and focal length to match the closer framing of the reference, and enable soft ambient occlusion shadows to ground the elements.
